# e2b_sandbox_metrics (Data Source)

Reads the latest E2B metrics for one or more running sandboxes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_sandbox_metrics" "running" {
  sandbox_ids = ["sbx_123"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sandbox_ids` (Set of String) Sandbox IDs to read metrics for. E2B allows up to 100 IDs.

### Read-Only

- `sandboxes` (Attributes List) Latest metrics keyed by sandbox. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sandboxes))

<a id="nestedatt--sandboxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sandboxes`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `cpu_used_pct` (Number) CPU usage percentage.
- `disk_total` (Number) Total disk space in bytes.
- `disk_used` (Number) Disk used in bytes.
- `mem_cache` (Number) Cached memory in bytes.
- `mem_total` (Number) Total memory in bytes.
- `mem_used` (Number) Memory used in bytes.
- `sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox ID.
- `timestamp` (String) Deprecated RFC3339 timestamp returned by E2B.
- `timestamp_unix` (Number) Unix timestamp for the metric point.
